snippet.title: ! [exclamation mark] ~ Part 1 / 2 (AGS)  Free Pixel Art Point and Click Adventure Game 5 colors
snippet.description:
This is a beautiful short adventure game made in 2009 by Ben Chandler (later known for his work on Technobabylon, the Blackwell series, Shardlight, etc). 
Using only 5 different colors and 6 different scenes all shown in splitscreen this title is very innovative and exceptionally experimental! The puzzles are also very nice to solve so I recommend you play this game yourself first before watching me solve the puzzles again I solved a thousand times before. I show the hint and the solution for the telephone puzzle but solve the balance puzzle straight away, I hope you get all the references for the balance puzzle this way.
The game is ~10 minutes long and even short when you click through the funny intro.

That fiendish Count Can't has gone and taken the town's monument for his evil purposes! The town's mayor has assigned !, Robot to the case - lend him your mind and your heart as you use your left mouse button to solve riddles and get the bad guy!
